villages.name: Ethan's Homestead
villages.summary: Where the roads meet. Workshop, garden, and the smoke that never goes out.

villages.name: Finance Tracker
villages.summary: Full-stack personal finance tracker with a Flask backend, React/TypeScript frontend, and Docker deployment.

villages.name: One Record, Many Bells
villages.summary: Durable agent-to-agent communication in a few hundred lines of stdlib Python — atomic file mailboxes as the record, pluggable notifications as the bell.

villages.name: kdoitall
villages.summary: KDE Plasma workspace automation — define a workspace once, then open and arrange every application across screens and virtual desktops with one command.

villages.name: PDF Merger & Converter
villages.summary: Web app that merges PDFs and converts documents and images to PDF on the fly, with automatic page numbering and duplex-friendly page alignment.

villages.name: War Card Game
villages.summary: Graphical implementation of the classic War card game supporting up to 100 players and 100 decks, with a real-time leaderboard and a Windows installer.

villages.name: Project Hub
villages.summary: Flutter application for hierarchical project management with a flexible metadata system and scope-based field organization.

villages.name: Montage-It
villages.summary: Automated collage and video-montage generation pipeline for large photo collections, driven by digiKam metadata and ffmpeg.

villages.name: Site Eight
villages.summary: The eighth holding. Stakes in, plot pegged out, first frames going up.

buildLog.text: The counting town pegged out on the north-east rise. Eleven plots surveyed.
West highway metalled as far as the ford; the mill wheel turns again.
Bell House finished. One record in the box, many bells on the roof.
Site Eight staked out at the south-west frontier. Stumps cleared, crane raised.
